app_name.description: The name of the application as identified in the configuration.

version.description: The version of the sqlitebrowser package.

default_db_path.description: The default directory where database files are stored or opened from.

startup_db.description: The path to a specific SQLite database file to open automatically on startup. Empty string means no default.

startup_query.description: A SQL query string to execute automatically on startup. Empty string means no query.

ui_theme.description: The user interface theme to use. Options: system, dark, light.

editor_font.description: The font specification for the SQL editor window.

enabled_plugins.description: A list of plugin names (SQLite extensions) to enable. For example: ['fts5']. In the INI file, these might be mapped differently, but this provides a clean list for templating logic if needed.
